observations_summary: The audit found significant deficiencies in district hospitals of Uttarakhand, including an inadequate policy framework, shortage of doctors and essential drugs, and lack of full radiology and pathology services. In-patient services suffered from non-functional ICUs, poorly equipped ambulances, and compromised patient safety. Maternity services were impacted by drug and equipment shortages, human resource non-compliance, and inadequate record-keeping. Infection control, bio-medical waste management, and infrastructure maintenance were also unsatisfactory.
